description: This PHP source file defines the 'Server' class used for serving documentation pages, handling HTTP requests, and generating responses within a documentation system. It includes methods for request handling, theme serving, temporary file creation, and response construction.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: A class responsible for handling incoming HTTP requests, serving documentation pages, managing themes, creating responses, and integrating with the Daux documentation system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Server instance with a Daux object, setting up the request and base URL.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Static method to start the server, configuring Daux, and serving the initial request.

methods.name: getTemporaryFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with a specified suffix, used for mime type detection.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Generates an HTTP response based on the provided Page object, handling raw pages, computed raw pages, and error pages.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and rebases the Daux configuration.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming request and returns the corresponding Page object, handling theme requests and page lookup.

methods.name: serveTheme
methods.description: Serves a theme file based on the request path.

methods.name: getPage
methods.description: Retrieves and generates the Page object for a given request path.
